title: “Starter Kit”
description:
The perfect set for someone who *really* loves to cook. Graza’s “Starter Kit” includes
our bestselling “Sizzle” and “Drizzle” Duo, 2x refill cans, and a funnel for easy refilling!

title: “Sizzle” Refill Can
description:
Our “beer can refills” are the ultimate olive oil refill solution — nitrogen-sealed and fully opaque to protect against oxidation and ensure maximum freshness, perfectly portioned for Graza’s iconic squeeze bottles, and 100% recyclable.
Before you say “EVOO isn’t for cooking,” read this: Thanks to the super stable Picual olive, Sizzle was born for the heat. It’s still 100% extra-virgin, but made with mid-harvest olives that give it a more mellow flavor.
